fields.description: Whose screen this is. Empty is a screen everyone on the workspace sees — Frappe's `for_user` empty, on List Filter.
fields.label: User

fields.description: The screen's slug, so two screens over one doctype keep their own answers.
fields.label: Screen

fields.description: The screen's name. Empty is the person's own unnamed default for this screen — what Save writes.
fields.label: Label

fields.description: A lucide name from the offered set, or an emoji. Anything else is dropped on the way in — a lucide name reaches the DOM as a class.
fields.label: Icon

fields.description: Opens this screen for whoever this screen belongs to.
fields.label: Is Default

fields.description: Which columns, in order, each with a width and an optional left/right pin. Empty follows the screen. The comma-separated fieldnames this used to hold still read.
fields.label: Columns

fields.description: Which column the rows are grouped under. Empty is no grouping.
fields.label: Group By

fields.description: Only rows this person liked. A flag rather than a filter on _liked_by: that column holds user ids, so a filter naming it could ask what a colleague liked.
fields.label: Favourites

fields.description: Which of the screen's view types this view is of. Empty is the screen's first.
fields.label: View Type

fields.description: What this view type needs that columns and filters do not carry.
fields.label: View Settings
